title: Brute Force / Credential Stuffing — 127.0.0.1
description:
Attack: High-frequency authentication attempts against login endpoints
Impact: Account compromise through weak password discovery, service degradation from authentication system overload, and potential lateral movement if credentials are reused across systems.
mitigation_steps: Force password resets for targeted accounts
Review login logs for successful unauthorized access
Enable account lockout after failed attempts
Verify MFA is enforced on all accounts
